notes: PARENTAGE OF DAUGHTER LIKELY UNSUBSTANTIATED LEGEND (research 2026-07-03): this woman's daughter, per the tree, is 'Charlotte Howe Taylor' — corresponding to the real, well-documented Charlotte Taylor (1755-1841) of Tabusintac, New Brunswick ('the Mother of Tabusintac'). Dedicated genealogical research (WikiTree Taylor-13772; charlottetaylor.ca 'Before Blake') finds NO record of a 'General Howe Taylor' (this woman's supposed husband) ever existing, and identifies Charles Taylor & Ann (no MacDonald connection) as the more probable parents based on period London christening records. This woman's own existence and 1730 birth year are themselves suspicious: 1730 is identical to the birth year given, in the same legendary tradition, for the supposed husband 'General William Charles Howe Taylor (1730-1788)' — likely a copy-paste/date-conflation artifact within the legend rather than an independently attested fact about her.
